Your holdings: SOXL (-34.59%) and SPAL (-33.28%) are both flagged 'SELL'. These leveraged ETFs are decaying and showing significant drawdowns, which are amplified by your margin use.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Micron's earnings report today, as it will set the tone for the entire semiconductor sector. Also, monitor any developments regarding AI regulation.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged, underperforming positions while staying alert for chip sector catalysts.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL given their 'SELL' status, leveraged nature, and significant drawdowns amplified by margin.
Watch MUU closely into Micron earnings; consider trimming if the report disappoints, given its leveraged nature.
Consider adding PLTR if it holds scanner entry 185.82-185.6, with a stop at 184.53, leveraging the strong AI narrative.
